description: This file contains the AuthUtil utility class which provides a static method to create HttpEntity objects with Basic Authentication headers for use in HTTP requests within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: AuthUtil
classes.description: Utility class for creating HTTP entities with Basic Authentication headers.

methods.name: createEntityWithBasicAuth
methods.description: Creates an HttpEntity with a body and headers that include Content-Type set to application/json, accept headers, and Basic Authentication credentials.
